# OpenAnalyst

> AI marketing agent platform that plans, creates, and optimizes campaigns across every channel.

OpenAnalyst is an AI-powered marketing automation platform with 42 specialized AI agents and 14 agentic skills that autonomously manage multi-channel marketing campaigns. The platform integrates with 27+ marketing tools and provides real-time campaign optimization, predictive analytics, and intelligent budget allocation.

## Core Capabilities

- **42 AI Marketing Agents**: Specialized agents for content creation, ad optimization, audience segmentation, lead scoring, competitor analysis, and more.
- **14 Agentic Skills**: Autonomous workflow engines that handle end-to-end campaign management without human intervention.
- **27+ Integrations**: Connect with Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, Stripe, Shopify, Salesforce, and more.
- **Multi-Channel Orchestration**: Coordinate campaigns across Email, Social Media, Paid Ads, SMS, and Web simultaneously.
- **Real-Time Optimization**: AI-powered feedback loops that continuously optimize campaigns for maximum ROI.
- **Predictive Analytics**: Forecast campaign performance, identify trends, and allocate budgets intelligently.

## Featured Agents

- **AI Vibe Marketer**: Full-stack marketing agent that orchestrates end-to-end campaigns with A/B testing and real-time performance analytics.
- **Content Strategist**: Generates high-converting copy, blog posts, ad creatives, and social media content.
- **Ad Optimizer**: Manages and optimizes paid advertising across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads.
- **Audience Analyst**: Segments audiences, builds lookalike profiles, and identifies high-value customer cohorts.
- **Lead Scorer**: Ranks and prioritizes leads based on engagement signals and conversion probability.
- **Competitor Intelligence**: Monitors competitor campaigns, pricing, and positioning in real-time.

## Pricing

- **Trial Pack**: $1 for 500 credits, 26 agents, 5 integrations (15-day trial)
- **Growth Pack**: $399/month for 25,000 credits, 42 agents, 27+ integrations, priority support
- **CLI (BYOK)**: Bring Your Own API Keys — pay only for orchestration credits

## Technology

- SOC 2 Type II certified
- GDPR compliant
- Your data never trains external models
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- Available on Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux
